performance.verdict: Meta delivering leads but 5 overdue SOW milestones block real attribution.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages (due 2026-07-31) all unconfirmed — 40+ days overdue; attribution and go-live blocked.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting (due 2026-08-01) show no evidence of going live — Google spend is $0 across all 28 days.
CPL fell 70.51% week-over-week to ~$74 on 7 leads; encouraging, but baseline is only 17 days of spend — too shallow to confirm a true CPL floor.
3-day lead signal (Sep 6–8: 1+1+2=4 leads) vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5: 0+1+1=2) shows doubling, but spend also rose from $9.72 to $73.51 on Sep 8 — volume gain is spend-driven, not efficiency-driven.
GBP actions hit 0 for 6 consecutive days (Sep 3–8) after averaging ~3.5/day prior — profile may be suppressed or unclaimed; 17 calls in 28 days at risk.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; LSA verification gap alone costs ~$5,000/mo in planned Google spend.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones — Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — were all due by 2026-08-01 and show no completion evidence. Google spend remains $0 across all 28 days, meaning ~$5,000/mo in planned search budget is undeployed. Nacer (Ops) must provide a status update and revised launch date by 2026-09-12. Success check: at minimum, LSA verification submitted and stack test passed by that date.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP profile — 0 actions for 6 straight days after averaging 3.5/day; confirm profile is active and not suppressed.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to zero from Sep 3–8 (6 consecutive days) after the profile had averaged approximately 3.5 actions/day. The prior 28-day window shows 17 calls and 66 total actions — a meaningful organic lead source that may now be dark. Check profile status, ownership verification, and any policy flags in Google Business Profile manager. Confirm profile is live and active by 2026-09-12; if suppressed, flag for Web/SEO to resolve.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL vs $74 baseline — hold budget flat until 14+ days of data confirms efficiency before any scale.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta CPL is $74 on only 17 days of active spend — too thin a baseline to scale confidently. The 3-day lead uptick (4 leads Sep 6–8 vs 2 prior) was spend-driven, not a pure efficiency gain. Hold daily budget at ~$47 and re-check on 2026-09-16. Success signal: CPL remains at or below $74 with at least 10 additional leads accumulated before any budget increase is considered.
